cook_seal_demon_pestilence.name: Plague-Seal Tonic
cook_seal_demon_pestilence.flavor: It tastes like sickness and leaves you immune to it.

cook_seal_demon_silence.name: Silence-Seal Consommé
cook_seal_demon_silence.flavor: Not a sound as you drink it; then every spell you know comes back louder.

cook_seal_demon_war.name: War-Seal Ichor Roast
cook_seal_demon_war.flavor: It smells of iron and smoke; your arms remember every war.

cook_seal_demon_wrath.name: Wrath-Seal Ichor Stew
cook_seal_demon_wrath.flavor: Furious in the pot; you want to hit something, hard.

cook_shade.name: Gloom-Jelly on Toast
cook_shade.flavor: Cold and dim; the dark grows grey and easy.

cook_shadow_demon.name: Smoke Ichor Tea
cook_shadow_demon.flavor: Pale as ash; the shadows thin to nothing.

cook_shadow.name: Shadow Aspic
cook_shadow.flavor: Slips down fast; you slip past blows.

cook_shambling_mound.name: Compost Jar Stew
cook_shambling_mound.flavor: Smells like a garden; you feel fresh and whole.

cook_shield_guardian.name: Ward Core Broth
cook_shield_guardian.flavor: Every blow after this one lands a little softer.

cook_skeleton.name: Bone-Marrow Gruel
cook_skeleton.flavor: Plain, filling and in good supply.

cook_sluagh.name: Flock-Bone Broth
cook_sluagh.flavor: Dark and cold; magic gathers like birds.

cook_sobek_warrior.name: Nile Crocodile Sausage
cook_sobek_warrior.flavor: Strong and toothy; your jaw sets.

cook_soul_eater.name: Soul-Hum Broth
cook_soul_eater.flavor: Cold blue broth; the souls inside turn to mana.

cook_spectral_dragon.name: Ghost-Dragon Aspic
cook_spectral_dragon.flavor: Wobbly blue jelly that tingles with spells.

cook_sphinx.name: Riddler's Steak
cook_sphinx.flavor: You think of three answers before you finish chewing.

cook_spriggan.name: Root-Acorn Mash
cook_spriggan.flavor: Stringy and solid; you feel twice your size.

cook_star_spawn.name: Starlight Ink Noodles
cook_star_spawn.flavor: Black noodles that taste of empty sky.

cook_starnut.name: Toasted Starnuts
cook_starnut.flavor: Crunchy, sweet and faintly fizzy; your mana stirs.

cook_stirge_swarm.name: Stirge Drumsticks
cook_stirge_swarm.flavor: Red and rich; your blood comes back.

cook_stone_giant.name: Rock-Salt Link Skillet
cook_stone_giant.flavor: Salt and stone; you feel built of granite.

cook_stone_golem.name: Granite Heart Stone Soup
cook_stone_golem.flavor: Gritty, heavy, and it makes you feel heavy in the good way.

cook_storm_elemental.name: Thunderhead Froth
cook_storm_elemental.flavor: It fizzes and crackles; lightning loses interest in you.

cook_storm_giant.name: Thunder Sausage Skillet
cook_storm_giant.flavor: It spits sparks; lightning stops hurting you.

cook_strigoi.name: Coal-Eye Bone Soup
cook_strigoi.flavor: Your eyes glow in the dark for a while.

cook_stymphalian_bird.name: Rattle-Roast Drumstick
cook_stymphalian_bird.flavor: Pluck the bronze feathers first; then eat your fill.

cook_sunroot.name: Roasted Sunroot
cook_sunroot.flavor: Sweet and filling, like a warm afternoon.

trophy_surtur_recipe.name: Lavabread
trophy_surtur_recipe.flavor: Lavabread — the ember at the middle stays hot for good.

cook_talos.name: Bronze Heart Flambé
cook_talos.flavor: It glows in the pan; you lift it one-handed afterwards.

cook_tengu_warrior.name: Mountain Tengu Ham
cook_tengu_warrior.flavor: Salty and quick; your blade hand twitches.

cook_the_sphinx.name: Riddle of the Ages Steak
cook_the_sphinx.flavor: Morning, noon and evening; you understand.

cook_thoth_construct.name: Scribe's Ink Core Tea
cook_thoth_construct.flavor: Tastes of papyrus and ink; the words of power come easier.

cook_thunderbird_lesser.name: Storm-Seared Loin
cook_thunderbird_lesser.flavor: Lightning in the pan, and none in you afterwards.

trophy_tiamat_recipe.name: Five-Element Brew
trophy_tiamat_recipe.flavor: Five-Element Brew — every color of dragon runs cold-then-hot in the throat.

cook_titan.name: Titan Haunch Roast
cook_titan.flavor: A roast for a god; your body feels unbreakable.

cook_troglodyte.name: Smoked-Out Musk Haunch
cook_troglodyte.flavor: Filling, and only a little smelly.

cook_troll.name: Troll Sausage Hotpot
cook_troll.flavor: Green and lumpy; your wounds mend while you chew.

cook_ugallu_demon.name: Lion-Demon Blood Stew
cook_ugallu_demon.flavor: Red, roaring and good for the arms.

cook_unicorn_corrupted.name: Bitter Unicorn Roast
cook_unicorn_corrupted.flavor: Sour at first, then clean; poison finds no grip.

cook_valkyrie_shade.name: Valhalla Bone Broth
cook_valkyrie_shade.flavor: A warrior's broth; your arms are ready for Ragnarok.

cook_vampire.name: Vampire Bone Black Pudding
cook_vampire.flavor: Rich and dark; your wounds close like a vampire's.

cook_violet_fungus.name: Spore-Stalk Sauté
cook_violet_fungus.flavor: Earthy and strange; your eyes catch every drift of spores.

cook_void_crawler.name: Slip-Ink Fry-Up
cook_void_crawler.flavor: It slides off the fork and you slide past the next blow.

cook_void_elemental.name: Nothing-Jar Soup
cook_void_elemental.flavor: A bowl of nothing at all, and magic slides off you.

cook_void_leviathan.name: Leviathan Blubber Roast
cook_void_leviathan.flavor: A slab of dark fat that keeps you fed for days.

cook_void_seraph.name: Ash-Light Ichor Tea
cook_void_seraph.flavor: It burns cold and bright; your spells catch fire.

cook_void_wyrm.name: Night-Scale Consommé
cook_void_wyrm.flavor: Clear and starry; the void fills your mana.

cook_vrock.name: Vulture-Dance Bile Soup
cook_vrock.flavor: It makes you want to dance, and dodge.

cook_vrykolakas.name: Warm-Bone Broth
cook_vrykolakas.flavor: It stays warm, and your wounds close.

cook_water_elemental.name: Tide Jar Broth
cook_water_elemental.flavor: Clean and cool; it washes your hurts away.

cook_wendigo.name: Hunger-Bone Broth
cook_wendigo.flavor: A strange broth that eats hunger itself.

cook_werebear.name: Werebear Leg Stew
cook_werebear.flavor: Thick and warm; it mends you like a long sleep.

cook_weretiger.name: Tiger-Moon Leg Roast
cook_weretiger.flavor: Lean and lithe; you move like a big cat.

cook_werewolf.name: Full-Moon Steak
cook_werewolf.flavor: Rare and wild; your senses sharpen.

trophy_whispering_crone_recipe.name: Wyrd-Whisper Tea
trophy_whispering_crone_recipe.flavor: Wyrd-Whisper Tea — the old voice teaches you to listen wider.

cook_wild_hunt_captain.name: Wild Hunt Spark Punch
cook_wild_hunt_captain.flavor: It sets your heart galloping, and your feet with it.

cook_will_o_wisp.name: Wisp-Light Bone Broth
cook_will_o_wisp.flavor: A green glow, and your mana glows with it.

cook_winter_wolf.name: Frostbreath Shank
cook_winter_wolf.flavor: Icy fat that keeps the cold off your bones.

cook_wolf_pack_leader.name: Pack Leader Steak
cook_wolf_pack_leader.flavor: Rare and wild; you feel like the head of the pack.

cook_wood_golem.name: Oak-Sap Crystal Tea
cook_wood_golem.flavor: Woody and slow; your feet feel rooted.

cook_world_serpent.name: World-Scale Soup
cook_world_serpent.flavor: Bitter green broth; poison cannot touch you.

cook_wormwood_blight.name: Wormwood Bitters
cook_wormwood_blight.flavor: So bitter your thoughts wake up.

cook_wraith.name: Wraith Ectoplasm Jelly
cook_wraith.flavor: Glowing blue jelly; mana floods in, cold and clear.

cook_wyrm.name: Whip-Scale Stir-Fry
cook_wyrm.flavor: Fast in the wok and fast in the hands.

cook_wyvern.name: Tail-Scale Soup
cook_wyvern.flavor: Bitter green broth; poison runs off you.

cook_xorn.name: Crunchy Gravel Granola
cook_xorn.flavor: Sounds like rocks; makes you strong enough to move them.

cook_yellow_mold.name: Mold Log Hash
cook_yellow_mold.flavor: Earthy and filling; the mold is the good kind now.

trophy_ymir_last_spawn_recipe.name: Primordial Stew
trophy_ymir_last_spawn_recipe.flavor: Primordial Stew — the great frost quiets inside you.

cook_young_black_dragon.name: Bog-Scale Crisps
cook_young_black_dragon.flavor: Sour and crunchy; acid stops biting you.

cook_young_dragon.name: Heart-Scale Stew
cook_young_dragon.flavor: Slow and rich; your wounds close like a dragon's.

cook_young_red_dragon.name: Fire-Scale Flambé
cook_young_red_dragon.flavor: Set alight, and it does not even blacken.

cook_yuan_ti_pureblood.name: Temple-Smoked Haunch
cook_yuan_ti_pureblood.flavor: Smoky, with a strange tingle of magic.

cook_zombie.name: Shinbone Marrow Soup
cook_zombie.flavor: Boil it twice. Then it mends you.

feast_01.name: The Bull-King's Wrath Feast
feast_01.flavor: Horn, rage and grave-iron in one pot; you rise from it twice as strong.

feast_02.name: Witch-Oven Labyrinth Roast
feast_02.flavor: Baked in a hedge-witch's oven until the horn-crown cracks, and every wound shuts.

feast_03.name: Gorgon's Ironblood Antidote Supper
feast_03.flavor: Gorgon blood cuts both ways. Tonight it cuts toward you.

feast_04.name: Athena's Owl-Wise Platter
feast_04.flavor: A sky-giant's ham and an owlbear's steak, served with the blood Athena blessed.

feast_05.name: Sigurd's Hearth Roast
feast_05.flavor: Roast the dragon's heart as Sigurd did, and burn your thumb on it too.

feast_06.name: Dragonfire Cassoulet
feast_06.flavor: A pot that has been on fire for a week, and you never feel the heat.

feast_07.name: Ragnarok Eve Feast
feast_07.flavor: The meal of the last night before the end; your arms could break chains.

feast_08.name: Wolf-Age Black Pudding Banquet
feast_08.flavor: Dark, enormous, and almost impossible to die after.

feast_09.name: Bottomless Pit Reduction
feast_09.flavor: Bitter as the last trumpet; your mind sees to the bottom of everything.

feast_10.name: Locust-Heart Mana Feast
feast_10.flavor: Every spell the dark lords hoarded, ladled out in one sitting.

feast_11.name: Green Chapel Yule Feast
feast_11.flavor: Holly, haunch and a beheading game you cannot lose.

feast_12.name: Evergreen Undying Stew
feast_12.flavor: Whatever is cut grows back, like the Green Knight's head.

feast_13.name: Root of the World Consommé
feast_13.flavor: Drawn from the roots of the World Tree; magic wells up like sap.

feast_14.name: Serpent-King's Antidote Broth
feast_14.flavor: Every venom of the nine worlds, boiled until it is a cure.

feast_15.name: The Norns' Supper
feast_15.flavor: The three who spin fate eat this. For one night, so do you.

feast_16.name: Crone's Midnight Cauldron
feast_16.flavor: Whispers rise from the pot, and every one of them is a spell.

feast_17.name: Crimson Court Banquet
feast_17.flavor: Blood for blood; the red court never leaves the table hurt.

feast_18.name: Warlord's Blood Feast
feast_18.flavor: A feast for kings who win by the sword alone.

feast_19.name: Five-Fire Dragon Platter
feast_19.flavor: Five colours of fire on one plate, and none of them burns you again.

feast_20.name: Chaos-Sea Starlight Feast
feast_20.flavor: From Tiamat's salt sea at the beginning of the world; mana rolls in like the tide.

feast_21.name: Signed-in-Blood Supper
feast_21.flavor: Every clause protects you. Read the small print later.

feast_22.name: Hellfire Prince's Banquet
feast_22.flavor: The Prince of Hell's own table, and you walk away whole.

feast_23.name: Muspelheim Forge Roast
feast_23.flavor: Cooked on Surtur's coal; the world could burn and you would not.

feast_24.name: Flaming Sword Feast
feast_24.flavor: The strength of the giant who will set the world alight.

feast_25.name: Ginnungagap Frost Feast
feast_25.flavor: From the frozen gap before the world began; cold forgets your name.

feast_26.name: First Giant's Marrow Feast
feast_26.flavor: The world was built from Ymir's bones. Now you are, too.

feast_27.name: Stone-Heart Giant's Banquet
feast_27.flavor: Thor needed his hammer to break the heart in this pot.

feast_28.name: Whetstone Hearth Pie
feast_28.flavor: Baked as hard as Hrungnir's whetstone; you mend as hard.

feast_29.name: First Seal Wrath Feast
feast_29.flavor: Wrath, simmered for a thousand years and served hot.

feast_30.name: Plague-Breaker's Feast
feast_30.flavor: Every sickness in one bowl, cooked into the cure.

feast_31.name: End-of-Famine Banquet
feast_31.flavor: Mammon's hoard thrown open at last: a feast for the starving.

feast_32.name: King of Hell's War Roast
feast_32.flavor: Bael led sixty legions. One bite and you could too.

feast_33.name: Last Breath Broth
feast_33.flavor: Death's own kitchen; nothing more will ever be taken from you.

feast_34.name: Earthshaker's Feast
feast_34.flavor: The ground shook for this meal. Afterwards, you will not.

feast_35.name: Seventh Seal Silent Supper
feast_35.flavor: Eaten in perfect silence; then every spell you know answers at once.

feast_36.name: Hut-on-Chicken-Legs Banquet
feast_36.flavor: Baba Yaga cooked it, and for once she let the guest eat.

dish_001.name: War-Wolf Steak Sandwich
dish_001.flavor: Hellish marinade on a wolf steak, wrapped in elf-bread.

dish_002.name: Infernal Sausage Cassoulet
dish_002.flavor: Sausage braised in war ichor and iron; heavy as a siege.

dish_003.name: Flame-Whip Fondue
dish_003.flavor: Dip the bread in molten rock. It does not burn.

dish_004.name: Brimstone Hot Sauce
dish_004.flavor: Two demons' fire in one bottle; your tongue stops caring.

dish_005.name: Chimera Wildfire Steak
dish_005.flavor: Seared over its own fire-breath; flame slides off you.

dish_006.name: Ember Marrow Barbecue
dish_006.flavor: Cooked over bones that never stopped burning.

dish_007.name: Glow-and-Gloom Skewers
dish_007.flavor: A beetle's lamp and a mummy's linen; the dark opens like a door.

dish_008.name: Night-Sky Aspic
dish_008.flavor: Black jelly salted with river stars.

dish_009.name: Rot-and-Regrow Hash
dish_009.flavor: One part grows back, the other rots back into the bog; either way, you mend.

dish_010.name: Monster Mixed Grill
dish_010.flavor: Three beasts and a troll on one grill, with moss for the burns.

dish_011.name: Lightning-Strike Stir-Fry
dish_011.flavor: Fast in, fast out. So are you.

dish_013.name: Sentry's Supper Stew
dish_013.flavor: Eaten on watch; nothing creeps up on you after.

dish_014.name: Riddler's Ploughman's Plate
dish_014.flavor: A riddle, an ossuary marrow and a wedge of cheese. The answer is wisdom.

dish_015.name: Sphinx and Soul Broth
dish_015.flavor: Two riddles of the Nile in one bowl.

dish_016.name: Illusionist's Curry
dish_016.flavor: It tastes like a different curry every spoonful, and all of them are magic.

dish_017.name: Head-in-the-Clouds Soufflé
dish_017.flavor: Light as a dream; you wake up wiser.

dish_018.name: Drowned Host Chowder
dish_018.flavor: Sea-prayers and restless wings; the mana comes in waves.

dish_019.name: Judgement Day Bread Pudding
dish_019.flavor: The crocodile god's soldiers and a demon-judge agree on one thing: this pudding.

dish_020.name: Hound-Nose Mushroom Sauté
dish_020.flavor: So pungent you can smell around corners.

dish_021.name: Night-Hunter's Bone Soup
dish_021.flavor: Coal-red eyes and a hellhound's nose, in a bowl.

dish_022.name: Forest Floor Bear Stew
dish_022.flavor: Bear, acorn and the deep sea's kelp; you heal like the woods.

dish_023.name: Ancient Memory Fondue
dish_023.flavor: Cheese melted over a mana core. The aboleth remembers for you.

dish_024.name: Jotunheim Ham in Aspic
dish_024.flavor: Never thawed, and never needs to be.

dish_025.name: Thunderstorm Mixed Grill
dish_025.flavor: Three storms on one grill; lightning gets bored of you.

dish_026.name: Ghost-Dragon Mushroom Soup
dish_026.flavor: Creation's silt and a dragon's ghost; mana rises.

dish_027.name: Heracles' Armoured Roast
dish_027.flavor: Lion's hide and beetle's shell; blows glance off.

dish_028.name: Watchful Hearth Hotpot
dish_028.flavor: Everything in it knows when someone is coming.

dish_029.name: Ironclad Shell Pie
dish_029.flavor: A pie with a crust like plate armour.

dish_030.name: Demon Scholar's Dipping Sauce
dish_030.flavor: Cold and clever. Dip the bread and think.

dish_031.name: Midnight Crossroads Platter
dish_031.flavor: Night-wing and hound, eaten where three roads meet in the dark.

dish_032.name: Sky-Giant and Sky-Horse Roast
dish_032.flavor: Sky ham and sky-horse; your judgement soars.

dish_033.name: Sandstorm Skillet
dish_033.flavor: Desert spice and cave spice; your eyes catch everything.

dish_034.name: Hunter's Trencher
dish_034.flavor: Two noses' worth of meat on a bread plate.

dish_035.name: Behemoth Wine Stew
dish_035.flavor: One pot feeds a party. This one feeds a week.

dish_037.name: Dreamcatcher Broth
dish_037.flavor: Dreams and bone-magic in a thin silver broth.

dish_038.name: Giant's Harvest Hotpot
dish_038.flavor: Locust and ham hock; enough for a whole village.

dish_039.name: Pot-of-Plenty Pie
dish_039.flavor: Every crumb of the harvest, baked in one crust.

dish_040.name: Trap-Sense Pickle
dish_040.flavor: Sour enough to wake every sense you have.

dish_041.name: Whirlpool Grub Boil
dish_041.flavor: It swirls, it squirms, it fills.

dish_042.name: Bangers and Whirlpool Mash
dish_042.flavor: The sea's own appetite on a plate.

dish_043.name: Book of the Dead Sandwich
dish_043.flavor: Necromancy, scribe-ink and wraith-stuff; very magic, very filling.

dish_044.name: Star-and-Tide Bisque
dish_044.flavor: Salt sea and empty stars; mana floods in.

dish_045.name: Unravelling Bog Soup
dish_045.flavor: Spells come apart before they reach you.

dish_046.name: Long Winter Porridge
dish_046.flavor: Hunger itself, eaten. You will not feel it for days.

dish_047.name: Road-Weary Sausage Hash
dish_047.flavor: Every ration a long road ever needed.

dish_048.name: Fallen-Light Tonic
dish_048.flavor: Holy fire gone strange, steeped with herbs.

dish_049.name: Hoarder's Spore Puffs
dish_049.flavor: Mammon's gold baked into pastry; you will never be hungry.

dish_050.name: Bitter Riddle Steak
dish_050.flavor: Bitter as a hard question, and as good for you.

dish_051.name: Wild Hunt Skewers
dish_051.flavor: Winged horse on a hunter's spit; your heart gallops with the hunt.

dish_052.name: Stormrider's Cheese Toast
dish_052.flavor: Cheese, sparks and wasp-spice; you are gone before they swing.

dish_053.name: Fireside Tale Fry-Up
dish_053.flavor: Every rasher a story, every link a spell.

dish_054.name: Dragon-Blood Lizard Medallions
dish_054.flavor: Deep dragon's blood over little lizard tails; you heal fast.

dish_055.name: Silent Loch Consommé
dish_055.flavor: Not a sound from the bowl. Then the spells come roaring.

dish_056.name: Secret Pasture Stroganoff
dish_056.flavor: Creamy, rich, and very hard to come by. Moo.

dish_057.name: Cheeseburger of the Damned
dish_057.flavor: The best-kept secret in the dungeon.

dish_059.name: Bull-and-Bacon Royal Roast
dish_059.flavor: Two kings of cattle on one spit.

dish_061.name: Adventurer's Mixed Grill
dish_061.flavor: A bit of everything that tried to eat you.

dish_062.name: Devourer's Full Breakfast
dish_062.flavor: Black pudding, herbs and a leg of the Devourer.

dish_063.name: Sea Serpent Picnic Pie
dish_063.flavor: Packed for a long march; it mends what the march breaks.

dish_065.name: Mender's Hotpot
dish_065.flavor: Three things that heal faster than they should.

dish_066.name: Troll Sausage and Boar Pie
dish_066.flavor: Sausage, boar ham and herbs in one crust.

dish_067.name: Night-Mother's Iron Stew
dish_067.flavor: Iron, serpent and vampire bone; wounds close fast.

dish_068.name: Clean Blood Broth
dish_068.flavor: Washed clean; it heals the way the undead do.

dish_069.name: Sailor's Healing Chowder
dish_069.flavor: Kelp, moss and spring water: the old sailor's cure.

dish_070.name: Spellsalt Eye Platter
dish_070.flavor: Enchanted eye, enchanted bone, enchanted jelly.

dish_071.name: Jewel-Spark Skewers
dish_071.flavor: They glow on the stick, and then in your blood.

dish_072.name: Ghost Story Bread Pudding
dish_072.flavor: Cold spoonfuls full of the restless dead's magic.

dish_074.name: Scribe's Ghost-Ink Noodles
dish_074.flavor: Black noodles that write spells on your tongue.

dish_075.name: Loch-Side Hag Skillet
dish_075.flavor: Pond-hag, mushroom and a water-horse's spark.

dish_076.name: Sorcerer's Brimstone Platter
dish_076.flavor: A cursed sausage, an imp's brimstone and a demon's wish for a sauce.

dish_077.name: Mist-and-Stars Bisque
dish_077.flavor: Ink, wishes and mist; mana gathers like fog.

dish_078.name: Wishful Thinking Ramen
dish_078.flavor: Be careful what you wish for. It is delicious.

dish_079.name: Elf-King's Wishing Cordial
dish_079.flavor: Sweet, sly and brimming with mana.

dish_081.name: Frog-and-Mushroom Pie
dish_081.flavor: Wobbly gravy, frog sausage, two kinds of mushroom.

dish_082.name: First Floor Fry-Up
dish_082.flavor: Everything you killed on your first day, fried.

dish_083.name: Marsh Hunter's Boil
dish_083.flavor: Frog, harpy, mushroom and basilisk in one pot.

dish_089.name: Lucky Haggis
dish_089.flavor: Very lucky, very filling, very odd.

dish_090.name: Salted Haunch in Marrow Gravy
dish_090.flavor: Hearty road food; the jelly makes the gravy.

dish_091.name: Underworld Jambalaya
dish_091.flavor: Everything from the upper caves in one spicy pot.

dish_093.name: Sticky Mud Pudding
dish_093.flavor: It sticks to your ribs. Literally.

dish_094.name: Goblin and Whirlpool Hotpot
dish_094.flavor: Gristle and shank, stewed until both give in.

dish_095.name: Ploughman's Monster Board
dish_095.flavor: Cold links, cold ham, cheese and bread: the crawler's lunch.

dish_096.name: Ceiling-Drop Sausage Roll
dish_096.flavor: It drops onto your plate before you are ready.

dish_097.name: Giant's Breakfast Platter
dish_097.flavor: Four kinds of meat. You will not need lunch.

dish_098.name: Between Two Monsters Chowder
dish_098.flavor: Scylla on one side, the whirling tide on the other, and a bowl in the middle.

dish_099.name: Sour Rust Relish
dish_099.flavor: So sour that acid gives up.

dish_100.name: Corrosion-Proof Crisps
dish_100.flavor: Crunchy and sour, and acid finds nothing to bite.

dish_101.name: Midwinter Ice Platter
dish_101.flavor: Four things from the frozen north, and you never feel cold.

dish_102.name: Snowbound Hunter's Stew
dish_102.flavor: A pot for the long frost.

dish_103.name: Blizzard Roast
dish_103.flavor: Roasted in a snowstorm; the cold forgets you.

dish_104.name: Glow-Beetle Smoke Glaze
dish_104.flavor: A lamp and a shadow; the dark grows clear.

dish_105.name: Blackout Steak Platter
dish_105.flavor: Eaten with the lights out, on purpose.

dish_106.name: Cave Picnic Terrine
dish_106.flavor: Pressed meats for a picnic in the dark.

dish_107.name: Bat-God's Smoked Roulade
dish_107.flavor: Smoky dark meat; the night turns grey.

dish_108.name: Lightless Mixed Grill
dish_108.flavor: Nothing on this grill ever saw the sun.

dish_109.name: House of Bats Hotpot
dish_109.flavor: The Maya bat-god's own pot; you see like a bat.

dish_110.name: Now-You-See-Me Tempura
dish_110.flavor: Is it on the plate? Is it in your mouth? Yes.

dish_111.name: Glamour Steak Sandwich
dish_111.flavor: Bite it and it is not quite where you bit.

dish_112.name: Trickster's Trail Pie
dish_112.flavor: Shape-shifter spice in a traveller's pie; enemies swing at your shadow.

dish_113.name: Flicker-Meat Skewers
dish_113.flavor: Half the skewer is in another world.

dish_114.name: Tomb Bread and Bone Soup
dish_114.flavor: Grave food; it keeps what is yours.

dish_115.name: Weighing of the Heart Stew
dish_115.flavor: Anubis weighs it and finds it good.

dish_116.name: Jackal-God's Salt Broth
dish_116.flavor: Salt and bone; nothing can be taken from you.

dish_117.name: Fearless Rider's Steak
dish_117.flavor: The Valkyrie and the hound of Hades fear nothing. Now neither do you.

dish_118.name: Gates of Hades Hotpot
dish_118.flavor: Eaten at the gate of the underworld; fear waits outside.

dish_119.name: Sun-Serpent Brimstone Roast
dish_119.flavor: Sun and sulphur; fire stops biting.

dish_120.name: Drake-Scale Chimera Chili
dish_120.flavor: Hot enough to breathe fire, and you do not feel it.

dish_121.name: Lava-Rock Dragon Crackling
dish_121.flavor: Cooked on a hot stone, the hottest stone there is.

dish_122.name: Inferno Mixed Grill
dish_122.flavor: Four fires at once, and not one touches you.

dish_123.name: Whirlwind Wasp Couscous
dish_123.flavor: Hot sand and buzzing spice; you are suddenly very quick.

dish_124.name: Storm-Chase Punch
dish_124.flavor: Wind in a cup; your feet leave before you do.

dish_125.name: Nothing-and-Nowhere Fondue
dish_125.flavor: Cheese melted over pure emptiness; spells fall straight through you.

dish_126.name: Empty Larder Stew
dish_126.flavor: It tastes of the end of things, and magic loses its grip.

dish_127.name: Venom-Proof Gumbo
dish_127.flavor: Three poisons in one pot make one antidote.

dish_128.name: Wyvern-and-Centipede Skillet
dish_128.flavor: Venom twice over; bites lose their sting.

dish_129.name: Antidote Platter
dish_129.flavor: Everything on it has fought poison and won.

dish_131.name: Regrowth Salad
dish_131.flavor: Green, alive and still growing on the plate.

dish_133.name: Life-and-Unlife Broth
dish_133.flavor: A tree's life and a vampire's unlife; both mend.

dish_134.name: Hydra Head Pie
dish_134.flavor: Cut a slice and two grow back.

dish_135.name: Ever-Growing Stew
dish_135.flavor: The pot is fuller when you finish than when you started.

dish_136.name: Limber-Limb Stew
dish_136.flavor: Everything that paralyses, cooked until it cannot.

dish_137.name: Stoneproof Chicken Soup
dish_137.flavor: Grandma's cure, if Grandma fought gorgons.

dish_138.name: Basilisk Stone Soup
dish_138.flavor: The old stone soup trick, with a stone that fights stone.

dish_139.name: Unbending Bone Pie
dish_139.flavor: Nothing binds you after a slice.

dish_140.name: Rune-Salted Tail Steak
dish_140.flavor: Salt, runes and basilisk; your limbs stay free.

dish_141.name: Salt-Circle Marrow Toast
dish_141.flavor: A ring of salt on the plate; no trick of the mind gets through.

dish_142.name: Guardian's Mushroom Broth
dish_142.flavor: Firm, salty and sure of itself.

dish_143.name: All-Seeing Roulade
dish_143.flavor: The eye in the middle sees what hides.

dish_144.name: Seer's Ward Custard
dish_144.flavor: It looks at you. Then you can see what cannot be seen.

dish_145.name: Lightning Rod Roast
dish_145.flavor: It drew every bolt in the cave; now none come to you.

dish_146.name: Thunderhead Herb Soup
dish_146.flavor: It crackles, and lightning loses its sting.

dish_148.name: Watchdog's Toast
dish_148.flavor: Smoky and alert; you hear everything.

dish_149.name: Barrow-Root Mash
dish_149.flavor: Heavy and earthy; you feel twice your size.

dish_150.name: Oak-and-Barrow Broth
dish_150.flavor: Old wood and old bone; you stand firm.

dish_153.name: Iron-Gut Cheese Bake
dish_153.flavor: If you can eat this, you can survive anything.

dish_154.name: Gatekeeper's Hash
dish_154.flavor: Stubborn ingredients for a stubborn eater.

dish_155.name: Granite Ox Pie
dish_155.flavor: Two oxen and a stone: the heaviest pie in the dungeon.

dish_158.name: Mountain Heart Sausage Bake
dish_158.flavor: Rock salt, iron and earth; you are built of stone.

dish_159.name: Iron-and-Stone Bangers
dish_159.flavor: A stone giant's links and an iron golem's heart, both as hard as anvils.

dish_160.name: Strike-First Steak Sandwich
dish_160.flavor: Two of the fastest strikers, between two slices.

dish_162.name: Pixie Marrow Toast
dish_162.flavor: It hops off the plate. Catch it.

dish_164.name: Restless Sea Roulade
dish_164.flavor: It will not keep still on the plate.

dish_165.name: Swordsman's Mixed Grill
dish_165.flavor: Every quick thing in the upper caves.

dish_166.name: Light-Fingers Platter
dish_166.flavor: Food for thieves, and for anyone who has to duck.

dish_167.name: Pickpocket's Bacon Roll
dish_167.flavor: Quick to eat, quick to run.

dish_168.name: Weaver's Blink Steak
dish_168.flavor: Neat, nimble and gone in a flash.

dish_169.name: Twitchy Sausage Skillet
dish_169.flavor: It jumps in the pan, and so will you.

dish_171.name: Tiger-Rib Fricassee
dish_171.flavor: Lean and quick, like a big cat.

dish_172.name: Two-Cat Supper Roll
dish_172.flavor: Cats land on their feet. So will you.

dish_173.name: Shadow-Cat Steak
dish_173.flavor: Silent, quick and hard to catch.

dish_175.name: Six-Armed Stir-Fry
dish_175.flavor: Six hands to cook it, and you will feel like you have six.

dish_176.name: Serpent-Dancer Noodles
dish_176.flavor: Whip-quick noodles in a serpent broth.

dish_178.name: Logic Puzzle Broth
dish_178.flavor: It only moves in straight lines, like your thoughts afterwards.

dish_180.name: Deep Thoughts Stew
dish_180.flavor: Slow and deep; your mind uncoils.

dish_181.name: Echo-and-Ink Steak
dish_181.flavor: A cave-echo steak in a scribe's ink; click, scratch, think.

dish_182.name: Scholar's Supper Platter
dish_182.flavor: Four strange meats for one sharp mind.

dish_184.name: Bad-Omen Broth
dish_184.flavor: Unlucky to look at, lucky to drink.

dish_185.name: Riddle-Root Ragout
dish_185.flavor: Many minds' marrow and a sphinx's wit.

dish_186.name: Brain Food Dumplings
dish_186.flavor: Clever stuffing for a cleverer eater.

dish_187.name: Mastermind's Banquet Pie
dish_187.flavor: Every clever monster of the upper dark, under one lid.

dish_188.name: Lookout's Mixed Grill
dish_188.flavor: Ears, nose and eyes, all on one grill.

dish_189.name: Echo-and-Tomb Pie
dish_189.flavor: You hear every echo and every footstep in the tombs.

dish_190.name: Odin's Lookout Platter
dish_190.flavor: A raven's eye on a hunter's board.

dish_193.name: Hunter's Moon Platter
dish_193.flavor: Every tracker in the dungeon, on one plate.

dish_195.name: One-Eye Shepherd's Pie
dish_195.flavor: Polyphemus never missed a sheep. You will not miss a thing.

dish_196.name: All-Night Watch Grill
dish_196.flavor: Owl, wolf and sentinel never sleep.

dish_199.name: Royal Hunt Roast
dish_199.flavor: A goblin king's table, finally earned.

dish_201.name: Wild Game Pie
dish_201.flavor: Stag-bird and wolf in a hunter's crust.

dish_202.name: Wolf-and-Python Braise
dish_202.flavor: Bite and squeeze; strength from both.

dish_205.name: Gate-Guard's Drumsticks
dish_205.flavor: What the guards of the underworld eat at the gate.

dish_206.name: Lion-and-Griffin Drumsticks
dish_206.flavor: Two lions' legs, one with wings.

dish_208.name: Labyrinth Monster Sandwich
dish_208.flavor: The two worst things in any maze, in one sandwich.

dish_209.name: Nile-and-Valhalla Stew
dish_209.flavor: A crocodile's bite and a valkyrie's arm.

dish_212.name: Colossus Brine Roast
dish_212.flavor: Bronze, bone and brimstone: the strength of giants.

dish_213.name: Stolen Cattle Hellbrine Bangers
dish_213.flavor: Smoky beef in a fierce brine.

dish_214.name: Bronze Giant's Mixed Grill
dish_214.flavor: Iron, bronze and beef; lift anything.

dish_215.name: Iron Marrowbones
dish_215.flavor: Roasted on an iron bed; strength in every scrape.

dish_217.name: Dream-and-Doom Broth
dish_217.flavor: You see what is coming, and see through it.

dish_219.name: Gorgon-and-Judge Sausage Roll
dish_219.flavor: Weigh your words. Eat your sausage.

dish_221.name: Gristle-and-Locust Harvest Pie
dish_221.flavor: Gristle saved from the top of the dungeon, locust from the bottom: one pie, and no hunger.

dish_222.name: Underdark Bat-Wing Skewers
dish_222.flavor: A trail snack of the deep tunnels; every rustle in the dark reaches you.

dish_223.name: Bonfire Chimera Grill
dish_223.flavor: Bones that burn and a beast that breathes fire, salted; heat slides off you.

dish_224.name: Two-Headed Hound Hotpot
dish_224.flavor: Two heads of smoky dog and a shinbone that will not stay buried; it mends you.

dish_225.name: Frozen Crypt Aspic
dish_225.flavor: Set in a cold tomb overnight; the cold never finds you after.

dish_226.name: Praying Mantis Stir-Fry
dish_226.flavor: Tossed fast and eaten faster; your hands move before you think.

dish_227.name: Grave-Nose Steak Roll
dish_227.flavor: A gravehound sniffs out the dead. After this, so do you.

dish_228.name: Straight-Line Scorpion Skewers
dish_228.flavor: Grid bug and scorpion on one stick; your thoughts line up like soldiers.

dish_229.name: Hollow-Bone Ration Stew
dish_229.flavor: Marrow from a hollow one, sausage from a hobgoblin's pack; it fills you up.

dish_230.name: Raven's Watch Sandwich
dish_230.flavor: Odin's raven sees everything. The Furies see the rest.

dish_231.name: Hopping Ghost Dumplings
dish_231.flavor: They bounce in the steamer, and the magic bounces into you.

dish_232.name: Swamp Hunter's Smokehouse Stew
dish_232.flavor: Smoked lizard, roast rat and cave mushrooms: a marsh supper.

dish_233.name: Mushroom-Man Hotpot
dish_233.flavor: Myconid stalk, harpy ham and goblin gristle, stewed in moss.

dish_234.name: Spore-and-Ham Pie
dish_234.flavor: A harpy's wing ham baked under a cap of talking mushroom.

dish_235.name: Dream-Dust Tea
dish_235.flavor: A pinch of pixie, a pinch of nightmare; the magic comes on a sneeze.

dish_236.name: Haunted House Toast
dish_236.flavor: It rattles on the plate and wails on the way down.

dish_237.name: Gutter Grub Sandwich
dish_237.flavor: Grub and jelly on bread: the cheapest full belly in the dungeon.

dish_238.name: Scarab-and-Pegasus Roast
dish_238.flavor: Desert shell and winged leg, roasted; wounds close as you chew.

dish_239.name: Desert Beetle Rump Bake
dish_239.flavor: Scarab and catoblepas baked under cheese; heavy, crunchy and healing.

dish_240.name: Smoke-and-Acid Glaze
dish_240.flavor: Dark smoke over a sour glaze; the shadows thin out.

dish_241.name: Midnight Mushroom Jelly
dish_241.flavor: Smoke-dark and toad-venom set in one jelly; your eyes drink the dark.

dish_242.name: Stirge-and-Rump Sandwich
dish_242.flavor: The stirge drank first. Now it is your turn.

dish_243.name: Bronze-Feather Fowl Pie
dish_243.flavor: Pluck the bronze feathers first, or bite carefully.

dish_244.name: Lake Stymphalia Hash
dish_244.flavor: Heracles chased these birds away; you cook them with hyena links.

dish_245.name: Tengu Wing Kebabs
dish_245.flavor: Wings of a sword-master; your feet learn his footwork.

dish_246.name: Spiced Mold Loaf
dish_246.flavor: Hyena links, dried meat and a log of yellow mold. It is better than it sounds.

dish_247.name: Mold-and-Cube Casserole
dish_247.flavor: Everything in the dungeon that grows on walls, in one dish.

dish_248.name: Blink-and-Gravel Grits
dish_248.flavor: Crunch, flash, gone; you are somewhere else before the blow lands.

dish_249.name: Maze-Runner's Loin Chops
dish_249.flavor: A minotaur never catches a blink dog. Eat both and dodge like one.

dish_250.name: Wand-and-Eye Bread Pudding
dish_250.flavor: A bone witch's wand, a beholder's eye and elf-bread: three kinds of magic, one spoon.

dish_251.name: Goblin Clan Sausage Supper
dish_251.flavor: Every goblin's cousin in one pot of bangers and gristle.

dish_252.name: Raider's Bangers and Links
dish_252.flavor: What raiders eat after the raid.

dish_253.name: Crypt Crawler Pot
dish_253.flavor: It eats the dead; you eat it. Very filling.

dish_254.name: Brimstone Crypt Broth
dish_254.flavor: A crypt thing's shank in imp fire; the magic hisses up.

dish_255.name: Glitter-and-Ink Cordial
dish_255.flavor: It sparkles, it writes, and it fills your mind with mana.

dish_256.name: Spectral Glitter Sorbet
dish_256.flavor: Cold, glittering and full of ghost-light magic.

dish_258.name: Jelly-and-Rat Roll
dish_258.flavor: A wobble of ochre jelly and one rat, wrapped in bread.

dish_259.name: Chattering Haggis
dish_259.flavor: It talks while it cooks. Eat it before it says something rude.

dish_260.name: Little Maker's Spark Pie
dish_260.flavor: A wizard's little helper and a scribe's ink heart, baked with elf-bread.

dish_261.name: Double Ooze Wobble
dish_261.flavor: Two oozes set in one mould; it wobbles all the way down.

dish_262.name: Demon-Wind Brine Broth
dish_262.flavor: Two fiends' juices, cooked clear; your thoughts turn quick and cold.

dish_263.name: Wild Fowl Fricassee
dish_263.flavor: Stag-bird and harpy in cream and mushrooms.

dish_264.name: Shape-Shifter's Cheese Plate
dish_264.flavor: The cheese keeps changing shape. So, for a while, do you.

dish_265.name: Red-Cap Ember Roast
dish_265.flavor: Hot as a redcap's temper, salty as a devil's brine.

dish_266.name: Bull-and-Acorn Pasties
dish_266.flavor: Hard-marching food with a fiery heart.

dish_267.name: Rust-and-Ward Crumble
dish_267.flavor: Sour and crumbly; acid slides off you like rain off a shield.

dish_268.name: Ghost-Light Marrow Soup
dish_268.flavor: Three cold glows in one bowl, and your mana warms up.

dish_269.name: Will-o'-Wisp Dragon Consommé
dish_269.flavor: A marsh light saved from the top floors meets a ghost dragon far below.

dish_270.name: Wood-and-Stone Golem Stew
dish_270.flavor: Oak sap and rune-stone; you stand like a wall.

dish_271.name: Snake-Priest's Supper
dish_271.flavor: Yuan-ti haunch and a beholder's eye: food for a temple of snakes.

dish_272.name: Ba-Soul Bread Pudding
dish_272.flavor: The Egyptian soul-bird, baked with elf-bread; it flies straight to your head.

dish_273.name: Soul-Market Hotpot
dish_273.flavor: Souls, bones and ectoplasm: a ghost market's supper, and full of magic.

dish_274.name: Jewel-Thief's Curry
dish_274.flavor: A carbuncle's jewel saved for a long time, glazed in a rakshasa's trick; pure mana.

dish_275.name: Stone-Ward Drumsticks
dish_275.flavor: A cockatrice leg saved from the top floors, basted in deep bile; nothing turns you to stone.

dish_276.name: Petrifier's Platter
dish_276.flavor: Two stone-gazers on one plate; their stare cannot hold you now.

dish_277.name: Fire-and-Ice Omen Stew
dish_277.flavor: A fetch is an omen of death. Eat it hot and cold, and know what is coming.

dish_278.name: Tentacle-and-Marrow Rolls
dish_278.flavor: Grick tentacle wrapped round bone marrow; chewy and clever.

dish_279.name: Necromancer's Tentacle Stew
dish_279.flavor: Dark learning and a cave-worm's coil; your thinking sharpens.

dish_280.name: Marrow-Wheel Sky Pie
dish_280.flavor: A marrow wheel from the shallow tombs, a ham from the clouds far below; wise and strange.

dish_281.name: Mud-and-Salt Gumbo
dish_281.flavor: Swamp leg and salted haunch, thick as the bog it came from.

dish_282.name: Mud-and-Locust Fry-Up
dish_282.flavor: A mud crawler from the top floors, a locust from the plague below: a meal for a famine.

dish_283.name: Stalactite Drip Soup
dish_283.flavor: Drips from the ceiling and stalks from the floor; you notice everything above you.

dish_284.name: Sewer-and-Abyss Bacon Butty
dish_284.flavor: Wererat bacon from the sewers, deep-one brine from the drowned deep.

dish_285.name: Heartwood Wyvern Salad
dish_285.flavor: A dryad's acorn sprouts in it, and your wounds close like bark.

dish_286.name: Sticky-Fingers Sausage Roll
dish_286.flavor: Light, quick and gone before anyone notices.

dish_287.name: Wolf-Cub War Stew
dish_287.flavor: A wolf pup's shank, saved and stewed in a demon knight's war-blood.

dish_288.name: Asgard Hunter's Shanks
dish_288.flavor: Wolf and Valkyrie, the two ends of every Norse saga.

dish_289.name: Cave-Dweller's Musk Stew
dish_289.flavor: It smells like a troglodyte. It fills like three.

dish_290.name: Troglodyte Musk Sandwich
dish_290.flavor: Thieves steal everything but troglodyte meat. Their loss.

dish_291.name: Grudge-Bone War Broth
dish_291.flavor: A revenant comes back for revenge; the demon knight's war-blood makes it strong.

dish_292.name: Restless Dead Marrowbones
dish_292.flavor: Two kinds of grave bone, roasted until the marrow gives up its strength.

dish_293.name: Serpent-and-Star Riddle Supper
dish_293.flavor: A serpent spawn saved from the top floors, a fallen star's bitter blood, and a sphinx's riddle.

dish_294.name: Coiled Serpent Steak Roll
dish_294.flavor: A sea-serpent's spawn wound round a sphinx steak: a riddle in every bite.

dish_295.name: Sun-Bird Roast
dish_295.flavor: Sun-serpent and roc, roasted golden; you glow and you heal.

dish_296.name: Fimbulwinter Shank Stew
dish_296.flavor: A winter wolf from the top floors and a frost giant from below; the long winter cannot touch you.

dish_297.name: Cog-and-Bronze Hash
dish_297.flavor: Gears and a bronze giant's heart; you think like a machine.

dish_298.name: Lion-and-Bear Mixed Grill
dish_298.flavor: Two of the forest's biggest, on one grill.

dish_299.name: Bugbear-and-Blubber Stew
dish_299.flavor: Bugbear bangers from the upper halls and blubber from a leviathan of the void; very, very filling.

dish_300.name: Otyugh Gut-Buster Hotpot
dish_300.flavor: If an otyugh can digest it, so can you; you come out of it tough.

dish_301.name: Grave-Warm Hotpot
dish_301.flavor: A vrykolakas's bone, still warm, with Ammit's leg; it mends and mends.

dish_302.name: Dragon-Heart Bone Broth
dish_302.flavor: A warm vampire bone from the shallow floors, a dragon's heart from the deep; every wound shuts.

dish_303.name: Weaver's Web Skillet
dish_303.flavor: Arachne wove faster than a goddess. A taste of her and your fingers fly.

dish_304.name: Keening Mushroom Soup
dish_304.flavor: It wails softly as it simmers; you hear warnings no one else does.

dish_305.name: Naga's Judgement Supper
dish_305.flavor: A naga, a sky-giant and a demon-judge at one table. Somebody will be wiser afterwards.

dish_306.name: Black Pudding Pie
dish_306.flavor: Made from a real black pudding. Yes, the ooze.

dish_307.name: Little Whirlpool Chowder
dish_307.flavor: Charybdis's spawn swallows the sea; this swallows your hunger.

dish_308.name: Clay-and-Tide Heart Stew
dish_308.flavor: Clay and tide, both built to last. So are you.

dish_309.name: End-of-Days Amber Roast
dish_309.flavor: A clay golem's heart, kept since the early floors, roasted in the herald's ichor.

dish_310.name: Many-Heads Mirage Steak
dish_310.flavor: Six legs, nine heads, and you are never quite where they strike.

dish_311.name: Headless Horseman's Stew
dish_311.flavor: One head too few, nine heads too many; fear cannot find you.

dish_312.name: Black Rider's Thunder Toast
dish_312.flavor: The headless rider and the lightning serpent; nothing frightens you after.

dish_313.name: Lightning-Reflex Platter
dish_313.flavor: Spark, snare and bronze; your hands are faster than your eyes.

dish_314.name: Primordial Silt Bisque
dish_314.flavor: Mud from the first sea and slime from the deep ones; old, strange magic.

dish_315.name: Scythe-Bone Lava Broth
dish_315.flavor: Death's own bone in a pot of magma; nothing can drain you.

dish_317.name: Pharaoh's Dragon Marrowbones
dish_317.flavor: A mummy's shank from the upper tombs, a dracolich's bone from the deep; your life stays yours.

dish_318.name: Embalmer's Salt Soup
dish_318.flavor: Salted like a mummy; your strength stays wrapped up tight.

dish_319.name: Temple Serpent Rolls
dish_319.flavor: A guardian naga's tail baked in temple bread, blessed twice.

dish_320.name: Night-Thunder Ink Stew
dish_320.flavor: The nue's cry and a star spawn's ink; your mind fills like a night sky.

dish_321.name: Surf-and-Turf Grill
dish_321.flavor: Sea serpent and owlbear on one grill; you mend from both ends.

dish_322.name: Compost-Baked Rump
dish_322.flavor: Baked slowly in a shambling mound's heat; it falls apart, and you mend.

dish_323.name: Vampire Hunt Supper
dish_323.flavor: A strigoi bone from the shallow crypts, a hellhound's nose from the deep, holy water to wash it down: you see what hides.

dish_324.name: Barrow-Wyrm Stew
dish_324.flavor: A lindworm's coil and a draugr's bone; you grow as tough as a barrow mound.

dish_325.name: Fallen-Star Serpent Sausages
dish_325.flavor: A lamia's sausage saved from the upper floors, glazed with ash-light from the void.

dish_326.name: Boar-Hunt Blood Roast
dish_326.flavor: The boar that took a hundred heroes, roasted with a vampire's bone.

dish_327.name: Bedrock Bangers
dish_327.flavor: Stone-giant links, brined in devil's salt and bedrock.

dish_328.name: Witch-Queen's Sausage Supper
dish_328.flavor: Medusa's snake-hair links, kissed by Rangda the witch-queen.

dish_329.name: Bone-Fence Hotpot
dish_329.flavor: Baba Yaga's fence is made of bones. So is this pot, and it mends you.

dish_330.name: Midgard Serpent Steak
dish_330.flavor: A young world serpent's steak with a draugr's bone; you hold like the earth.

dish_331.name: Serpent-and-Stone Pie
dish_331.flavor: Coils, runes and iron: a pie as tough as a mountain.

dish_332.name: Twenty-Armed Demon Curry
dish_332.flavor: Ravana had twenty arms. One bite and you could use them all.

dish_333.name: Demon-King's Brine Roast
dish_333.flavor: The demon king of Lanka's strength, brined and roasted.

dish_334.name: Anansi's Last Story Skillet
dish_334.flavor: Anansi owns every story. This one ends with you wiser.

dish_335.name: Trickster's Starnut Flatbread
dish_335.flavor: Elf-bread rolled with crushed starnuts and a dash of something that shimmers. Your thoughts sparkle.

dish_336.name: Troll Sausage and Starnut Bake
dish_336.flavor: A miner's supper: troll sausage baked with toasted starnuts in a bread crust. It sits heavy and warm.

dish_337.name: Rime Ham and Sunroot Hash
dish_337.flavor: Frost-cured ham fried with sweet sunroot and dried meat. Enough to march all day.

dish_338.name: Heart-Scale and Sunroot Stew
dish_338.flavor: Dragon heart-scale simmered soft with sunroot and healing herbs. It mends from the inside.

dish_345.name: Forge-Giant's Anvil Links
dish_345.flavor: Fire giants are the smiths of the deep. Their smoked links and a shaving of deep iron make an arm like a hammer.

dish_346.name: Lion-Strangler Roast
dish_346.flavor: No blade could cut the Nemean lion, so Heracles strangled it with his bare arms. Eat its leg with a bull-man ham and a python's coil, and see what yours can do.

dish_347.name: Old-Root Moss Pottage
dish_347.flavor: A treant acorn and a moss sentinel core: what a forest learns by standing still for a thousand years.

dish_348.name: Coiling Serpent Skewers
dish_348.flavor: The World Serpent's scale and a wyrm's coil: everything that slides out of a blow's way, on one stick.

dish_349.name: Leaping Locust Fritters
dish_349.flavor: The prophet Joel saw locusts run like horsemen and climb walls like soldiers. A shadow's gloom makes you just as hard to catch.

dish_350.name: Night-and-Coil Wyrm Kebabs
dish_350.flavor: Two wyrms of the deep and the void, and a shadow between them. You slip through the dark the way they do.

dish_351.name: Sky-Rider's Hunt Supper
dish_351.flavor: The Wild Hunt rides the storm across the sky and a seraph flies on six wings. Nothing down here will be quicker than you.

dish_352.name: Dreaming Mind Broth
dish_352.flavor: An astral horror's dream sac and a mind flayer's brain pouch: thoughts from beyond the stars, in a bowl.

dish_353.name: Frost-Bone Scholar Stew
dish_353.flavor: A lich gave up his life to know more. The Death Lord rules what the lich learned. Both lessons are in the pot.

dish_354.name: Faust's Bargain Tea
dish_354.flavor: Doctor Faust sold his soul to a demon for knowledge. This costs you only the tea.

dish_355.name: Morning Star Watch Supper
dish_355.flavor: Isaiah called the fallen one the morning star. A fallen angel's halo and a sentinel's watch-cube: you see as far as that light.

dish_356.name: Dragon's-Eye Night Skewers
dish_356.flavor: The Greek word for dragon, drakon, is said to come from 'to see clearly'. A void wyrm and a hellhound's nose: nothing hides from you.

dish_357.name: Night Watch Skewers
dish_357.flavor: A nightwing's void-marrow and a sentinel's watch-cube: nothing moves in the dark that you do not see.

dish_358.name: Titan's Forethought Roast
dish_358.flavor: Prometheus was a Titan, and his name means forethought. Eat like him and think ahead.

dish_359.name: Job's Whirlwind Supper
dish_359.flavor: God answered Job out of the whirlwind with Behemoth and Leviathan. Wisdom begins with knowing how small you are.

dish_360.name: Haunted Marrow Broth
dish_360.flavor: Three restless ghosts boiled down to one clear, cold broth; mana rises like mist.

dish_361.name: Hound-and-Centipede Sandwich
dish_361.flavor: Many legs and four, between two slices of bread.

dish_362.name: Spark-and-Wisp Skewers
dish_362.flavor: Two little lights on one stick; they glow all the way down.

dish_363.name: Treasure-Chest Bangers
dish_363.flavor: A mimic's glue from an early chest holds the bangers together. Very filling.

dish_364.name: Banshee's Wake Supper
dish_364.flavor: Keened over, prayed over and served hot; you come away wiser.

dish_365.name: Tide-and-Temple Chowder
dish_365.flavor: Sea-dragon scale and serpent-folk ham in a cream of the temple's sea; mana rolls in.

dish_366.name: Smoke-and-Toad Jelly
dish_366.flavor: A shadow demon's smoke and a toad-demon's venom set in black jelly; your eyes drink the dark.

dish_367.name: Vulture-Dance Stir-Fry
dish_367.flavor: The vrock's dance in a hot pan; your feet learn the steps.

dish_368.name: Stitched-Heart Hotpot
dish_368.flavor: A heart sewn back together and a bone that will not rot; you mend the same way.

dish_369.name: Stitch-and-Compost Hash
dish_369.flavor: One part sewn, one part grown from the bog; your wounds close.

dish_370.name: Cat-and-Hound Grill
dish_370.flavor: The monstrous cat of Anglesey and Fionn's hound on one grill, still racing.

dish_371.name: Witch-Queen's Lightning Supper
dish_371.flavor: Rangda's ichor and a grell's spark; a long night's thinking in one bowl.

dish_starnut_tart.name: Starnut Tart
dish_starnut_tart.flavor: The old miners' tart: starnuts and a sweet apple baked golden in a crust of ration bread, wrapped to carry down the shafts.

dish_caviar_and_tater_tots.name: Caviar and Tater Tots
dish_caviar_and_tater_tots.flavor: High and low on different plates, sitting at the same table tonight.

dish_339.name: Night-Owl Carrot Stew
dish_339.flavor: In the Second World War the British said their night pilots saw in the dark because they ate carrots. This carrot really does it.

dish_340.name: Wishing-Star Miner's Pie
dish_340.flavor: The old miners' tart baked again with a seam crystal, a fallen star's ink and a demon's wish. Every drop of your mana comes back.

dish_341.name: Out-of-Reach Plum Pudding
dish_341.flavor: In Tartarus every branch lifted its plum away from Tantalus's hand. You caught this one, and it mends what hurts.

dish_342.name: Hesperides Garden Supper
dish_342.flavor: For his eleventh labour Heracles took these apples from the garden the dragon Ladon guarded. Eat them with the dragon, and the lion and the hydra he beat first.

dish_343.name: Olympian Victory Banquet
dish_343.flavor: The gods of Olympus ate ambrosia after they threw down the Titans. Every wound closes, and for a moment you feel immortal too.

dish_344.name: Monkey King's Stolen Peach Supper
dish_344.flavor: Sun Wukong, the Monkey King, ate the peaches of immortality in Heaven's own orchard and no blade could kill him after. A dragon king and Heaven's soldiers could not stop him.

cook_mandrake.name: Mandrake Root Wine
cook_mandrake.flavor: The sleep-root boiled in wine, the old way: now nothing knocks you senseless.

dish_mm_mandrake_a.name: Physician's Root Broth
dish_mm_mandrake_a.flavor: Bitter and calming; your head stays clear when a blow lands.

dish_mm_mandrake_b.name: Mandrake and Apple Pickle
dish_mm_mandrake_b.flavor: Sour and sharp; you will not be stunned or put to sleep easily.

cook_kappa.name: Kappa Shell Soup
cook_kappa.flavor: Turtle soup from the river; you stand like a wrestler.

dish_mm_kappa_a.name: River-Imp Hotpot
dish_mm_kappa_a.flavor: Earthy and thick; you feel planted to the ground.

dish_mm_kappa_b.name: Pond Shell Steak
dish_mm_kappa_b.flavor: Green-edged and chewy; nothing throws you easily.

cook_eloko.name: Bell-Ringer Bone Broth
cook_eloko.flavor: Thin and grassy; afterwards every small sound is clear.

dish_mm_eloko_a.name: Hollow-Tree Stew
dish_mm_eloko_a.flavor: It smells of the forest floor; you notice things.

dish_mm_eloko_b.name: Forest Spirit Platter
dish_mm_eloko_b.flavor: Bone, cheese and leaves; your eyes and ears sharpen.

cook_ahuizotl.name: Roast Lake-Hound Haunch
cook_ahuizotl.flavor: Dark lake meat; you see the trick before it is played.

dish_mm_ahuizotl_a.name: Fisherman's Haunch Stew
dish_mm_ahuizotl_a.flavor: A fisherman's supper; your wits are quick.

dish_mm_ahuizotl_b.name: Salt-Crusted Lake-Hound Steak
dish_mm_ahuizotl_b.flavor: Baked in salt; you think a move ahead.

cook_bulgasari.name: Rice-Heart Cakes
cook_bulgasari.flavor: Chewy as iron and sweet as new rice; you feel hard to break.

dish_mm_bulgasari_a.name: Iron-Rice Porridge
dish_mm_bulgasari_a.flavor: Plain and heavy; it sits in you like an anvil.

dish_mm_bulgasari_b.name: Rice-Heart Fritters
dish_mm_bulgasari_b.flavor: Crisp outside, iron-hard within; you shrug off a blow.

cook_myrmekes.name: Gold-Ant Larvae Stew
cook_myrmekes.flavor: Buttery, nutty and rich as the gold they dug; it keeps you going for days.

dish_mm_myrmekes_a.name: Gold-Digger's Trail Stew
dish_mm_myrmekes_a.flavor: A raider's meal from the Indian desert; you could ride all day.

dish_mm_myrmekes_b.name: Ant and Beetle Roast
dish_mm_myrmekes_b.flavor: Crunchy and rich; hunger stays away a long while.

cook_vila.name: Mountain Cloud Cordial
cook_vila.flavor: Cold as a mountain cloud; the spells come quicker.

dish_mm_vila_a.name: Vila's Garland Chowder
dish_mm_vila_a.flavor: It smells of mountain flowers; your magic wells up.

dish_mm_vila_b.name: Cloud and Ember Jelly
dish_mm_vila_b.flavor: White and red, cold and hot; the power hums in you.

cook_taniwha.name: Earth-Oven Taniwha Steak
cook_taniwha.flavor: Steamed under hot stones; you feel like a river nobody can dam.

dish_mm_taniwha_a.name: River Guardian Stew
dish_mm_taniwha_a.flavor: Dark and deep; it sits in you like a riverbed.

dish_mm_taniwha_b.name: Taniwha and Lizard Roast
dish_mm_taniwha_b.flavor: Two kinds of scale on one spit; you are hard to hurt.

cook_mapinguari.name: Smoked Mapinguari Flank
cook_mapinguari.flavor: Smoked a whole day to kill the reek; the strength stays.

dish_mm_mapinguari_a.name: Rubber-Tapper's Moqueca
dish_mm_mapinguari_a.flavor: A fish-pot stew of the Amazon with a beast in it; your arms swell.

dish_mm_mapinguari_b.name: Two-Beast Roast
dish_mm_mapinguari_b.flavor: Two great beasts on one spit; you could lift a cart.

cook_impundulu.name: Lightning-Fat Flambe
cook_impundulu.flavor: It crackles in the pan; lightning finds nothing to hold.

dish_mm_impundulu_a.name: Lightning Bird Pie
dish_mm_impundulu_a.flavor: The crust sparks when you cut it; storms pass you by.

dish_mm_impundulu_b.name: Two-Bird Storm Roast
dish_mm_impundulu_b.flavor: Thunder on the tongue; lightning does not find you.

cook_preta.name: Ghost Festival Offering Stew
cook_preta.flavor: The Ghost Festival's meal, freely given; for once the hunger is filled.

dish_mm_preta_a.name: Ember-Roasted Offering Loaf
dish_mm_preta_a.flavor: Warm bread with a coal at its heart; you will not go hungry for a while.

dish_mm_preta_b.name: Grave-Offering Stew
dish_mm_preta_b.flavor: A meal set out for the dead and eaten by the living; it fills you up.

cook_star_jelly.name: Star-Rot Pudding
cook_star_jelly.flavor: It trembles on the spoon and tastes of a cold night; your thoughts come clear.

dish_mm_star_jelly_a.name: Starfall Apple Pie
dish_mm_star_jelly_a.flavor: Sweet apple under a shining glaze; you think more clearly.

dish_mm_star_jelly_b.name: Two-Jelly Platter
dish_mm_star_jelly_b.flavor: Pale and yellow jellies side by side; your mind is sharp.

cook_waq_waq_tree.name: Waq-Waq Fruit Platter
cook_waq_waq_tree.flavor: It tastes of nothing you know and listens as you eat it.

dish_mm_waq_waq_tree_a.name: Island Fruit Stew
dish_mm_waq_waq_tree_a.flavor: Strange and sweet; afterwards you hear the smallest step.

dish_mm_waq_waq_tree_b.name: Roc and Fruit Roast
dish_mm_waq_waq_tree_b.flavor: A roc chick stuffed with fruit from the edge of the world; your eyes miss nothing.

cook_yacumama.name: Mother-of-Waters Steak
cook_yacumama.flavor: Dense as a coil; you could crush a canoe.

dish_mm_yacumama_a.name: Salted Anaconda Stew
dish_mm_yacumama_a.flavor: Salted and slow-cooked; your grip tightens.

dish_mm_yacumama_b.name: Great Serpent Stir-Fry
dish_mm_yacumama_b.flavor: Two serpents in one pan; your arms are iron.

cook_reem.name: Re'em Sirloin Roast
cook_reem.flavor: One slice is a day's meat for a village.

dish_mm_reem_a.name: Wild Ox Pie
dish_mm_reem_a.flavor: A pie the size of a cartwheel; you will not be hungry for days.

dish_mm_reem_b.name: Hill-Beast Stew
dish_mm_reem_b.flavor: A stew of the two greatest beasts you know; it fills you for days.

cook_bakunawa.name: Moon-Scale Soup
cook_bakunawa.flavor: It shimmers like the moon on the sea; you move like the tide.

dish_mm_bakunawa_a.name: Eclipse Night Stew
dish_mm_bakunawa_a.flavor: Dark and bright by turns; your feet are quick.

dish_mm_bakunawa_b.name: Moon and Fire Stir-Fry
dish_mm_bakunawa_b.flavor: A serpent's scale and a drake's fire in one pan; your hands are swift.
